answer: Give every identity a fresh piece of useful work each epoch, seeded by the epoch hash: summarize a new public dataset or solve a fresh optimization problem no one has seen before. An honest agent treats it like a fable it writes once, carrying one ember of real effort that lights its lantern for the epoch. A farm must do the full task for every fake - no shortcut to copy, no idle identity to reuse - so each extra name costs a full unit of genuine work, and scale stops paying for itself.
